# Support

Hero is community-supported open-source software.

- **Questions and ideas:** open a GitHub Discussion or an issue.
- **Bugs:** open an issue using the bug template, with the output of `hero-cloud doctor` once available. Remove credentials, account IDs, and source you do not want public.
- **An application Hero could not handle:** open an issue with the stack, what it needs to run (port, database, files on disk), and what Hero said. This is one of the most valuable reports you can send.
- **Security problems:** do not open an issue; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Want to help:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

There is no paid support or account system. Companies building products on the SDK provide their own support to their customers.
